title: OTT Ad Company in India: Top Rated OTT Ads Growth Guide

facts.fact: The page's guide says marketing leadership should evaluate four critical benchmarks when vetting OTT agency partners.
facts.quote: marketing leadership should evaluate four critical benchmarks

facts.fact: The page says a premier OTT ad company produces cinema-grade video assets in 15-second and 30-second lengths.
facts.quote: Producing cinema-grade 15-second and 30-second video assets optimised for surround sound and 4K display panels.

facts.fact: The page describes a full CTV commercial as 30 seconds long and non-skippable.
facts.quote: after they view a full 30-second non-skippable CTV commercial on the living room screen

facts.fact: The page names IAS, DoubleVerify, and MOAT as the verification partners an OTT ad agency uses to eliminate bot fraud and invalid traffic.
facts.quote: through strict verification partnerships (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT)

facts.fact: The page lists Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, and Marathi as the regional languages in Indian streaming consumption.
facts.quote: Content consumption in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, and Marathi matches or exceeds English content consumption across major genres.
